title: Rocket to the Moon
description: Framed mixed-media collage densely layered with warplane silhouettes, concentric target rings, vinyl records, and a chess king piece rendered in ink. Magenta, yellow, and white paper blocks anchor the composition, with handwritten text including 'ROCKET' and 'Ant Man' visible along the lower register.
composition: dense vertical layering with framed inset border
keywords: vinyl record concentric rings layered paper
